news.title: The Little Probe That Could: Why Voyager 1 Matters, and Why NASA Just Switched Part of It Off - NPR

weekly_forecast: Voyager 1 gets downgraded to 'Voyager 0.5' as NASA plays cosmic resource management. Conspiracy theorists insist it’s a cover-up for alien communications. Elon Musk will tweet about launching his own probe just to one-up them, then forget by Tuesday. Meanwhile, astronomers sob quietly into their star charts.

lines: You’re already drafting a manifesto about how YOU could’ve kept Voyager running better.
NASA’s lack of hustle offends you deeply.

signs.name: Taurus
lines: You’d never turn off a 45-year-old machine. That’s basically vintage.
This week, you stubbornly refuse to update your phone’s OS in solidarity.

lines: One minute you’re defending NASA’s budget, the next you’re convinced Voyager is a hoax.
Your group chat is 90% conspiracy memes now.

Demand a tribute TikTok montage set to 'Space Oddity.'

signs.name: Virgo
lines: You’ve calculated exactly how long NASA could’ve stretched the power if they’d just turned it off 17 minutes earlier each day.
Their inefficiency haunts you.

signs.name: Libra
lines: Torn between 'let it rest' and 'fight for space justice.'
Posting vague polls about it counts as activism, right?

Excel spreadsheet titled 'Voyager ROI' open in the background.

lines: You’re convinced Voyager is sending coded messages through your dreams.
Spoiler: It’s just that weird pizza you ate.
